title: How Much Should a Small Business Spend on Advertising?
description: How much should a small business spend on advertising? Work back from what a customer is worth, with a worked example and a 4-week test plan.
h1_main: How Much Should a Small Business
dek: Work backwards from what a new customer is worth, not a round number. Set a target cost per enquiry, then commit to a test budget for at least four weeks.
primary_keyword: how much should a small business spend on advertising

faq.q: How much should a small business spend on ads?
faq.a: A small business should set its ad budget by working backwards from what a new customer is worth, not by picking a round number. Decide the most you'd pay to win one customer, estimate how many enquiries it takes to win one, and that gives you a target cost per enquiry. Then commit to a test budget you're comfortable spending for at least four weeks, so you have enough results to make a real decision.

faq.q: How do you work out your cost per enquiry?
faq.a: Not every enquiry becomes a customer. If you know roughly what share of enquiries you win, divide your target cost per customer by the number of enquiries it takes.
